explanation: The central tree retains the seed's seven conceptual branches while shrinking from 102 to 67 lines (34.3%) and from 6,858 to 4,752 characters (30.7%). Four peripherals expand parsing, logical identity and read isolation, scoped generation, and source-context dependencies. The decomposition mixes modular boundaries, call paths, ownership, and data dependencies without organizing the trees around files. Peripheral details absent from the seed include sourceId derivation, candidate-claim precedence, view field removal, and the distinction between stored tree nodes and cached diagram nodes. Source-grounded clarification: submitDiagramEdit.ts computes outside/inside mapping combinations for every scoped edit; diagramRevisionEditor.ts uses those supplied mappings only when retainMappings is false, otherwise selecting retainSourceMappings. The durable-flush statement is qualified as an adapter contract documented in diagramRevisionStore.ts, not an implementation demonstrated by these inputs. Mapping and annotation edits can issue new service revisions while preserving content and numeric revision. Evidence validation checks captured strings and their count, not their agreement with repository files. All claims use only the supplied point, seed, and pinned source text. Imported parser, patch, mapping-retention, registry, and durable-adapter internals were not supplied, so their internal behavior is not inferred. Coordinates were checked against actual text dimensions; edges use 1-based concept lines.
